title: Israel launches ‘limited counterterrorism’ op after 2 IDF troops killed in West Bank
content: In a post on X, the IDF said, "In response to the shooting attack in which 2 IDF soldiers fell, and several others were wounded, the IDF along with other security forces launched a targeted & limited counterterrorism operation in the Hebron area, from which the terrorists had emerged." The military said residents in areas where its forces are operating would be allowed to leave through three designated exit points.

title: Dan vs Daniel: Trump admin sues to block Alaska result if GOP candidate loses race
content: The lawsuit, filed in federal court in Alaska on Thursday, argues that the state must protect the integrity of federal elections. It asks the court to block the certification of a Peltola victory if Daniel Sullivan, a candidate from the small fishing community of Petersburg, remains on the ballot. “The United States accordingly brings this lawsuit to protect the integrity of the 2026 Senate election in Alaska,” the lawsuit says.

title: Video: Gunmen storm Jordan church during funeral, killing 7 and wounding 40
content: Jordan's government described the attackers as unknown assailants and said investigations were moving ahead at full speed. It did not immediately confirm whether any suspects had been arrested or killed. Footage aired by Jordanian state television showed two men appearing to carry pistols approaching the church and firing shots. A third man, apparently carrying a semi-automatic rifle, then approached and opened fire before all three ran towards the building.

title: China’s patrolling deviations disturb border: MEA on ITBP DG's face-offs remark
content: The ministry of external affairs (MEA) on Friday did not go into the specifics of the latest face-off, choosing to refer the issue to the defence ministry, but said Chinese divergence from established patrolling patterns created disturbances at the border from time to time. The official said both sides continued to use existing diplomatic and military mechanisms to resolve outstanding issues and avoid misunderstanding and miscalculation along the LAC.

title: Upper layer NBFCs have to list: RBI guv on Tatas; dispels doubts on Sept order
content: RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra’s comments also suggest Tata Sons is in breach of RBI rules. The consequences of continued noncompliance remain unclear. The governor declined to be drawn into the question of Noel Tata’s proposal to merge two Tata Sons subsidiaries with the holding company, a move that could help it sidestep a stock market listing.

title: Mark Zuckerberg says Meta's Muse chatbot adoption is strong, but AI may not stay free
content: Meta has launched its AI agent Muse, which is already being used by over 10 million people. CEO Mark Zuckerberg indicated that Muse's revenue potential could surpass that of Facebook and Instagram. Currently, shopping is the most common use case for the Muse agent, with consumers spending an average of $200 per purchase.

title: Ontario farmer turned down C$16m for 164 acres; 29 acres protected for 999 years
content: Charles Stevens and his family have decided to protect Wilmot Orchards by placing a conservation easement on the property. This easement effectively restricts future development for nearly 1,000 years, ensuring continued agricultural use. Their decision counters pressures from developers seeking to convert farmland into housing. The Stevens family aims to preserve the land for future generations of farmers.

title: Trump eases tariffs on Canadian imports weeks before US midterms
content: The White House said the changes would remove tariffs on certain products, including "plywood sheets, some paper products, certain machinery and refrigeration equipment". However, the administration will also introduce tariffs on other goods, including carpets, certain valves and waste products. The new measures will take effect on October 30. The United States and Canada have closely connected economies.

title: Cabinet Secretary didn’t act on EC’ plaint as it was unofficial: RTI
content: According to documents shared as part of an RTI response, two ECs in their separate but near-identical letters to Somanathan on July 29 objected to Garg’s conduct and an order he issued revising allocation of work among senior officers. The two ECs alleged the changes were made without prior discussion with the commission or officers concerned.

title: Centre bans reuse of single-use medical devices across hospitals
content: In a letter dated Oct 16, the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) said it had come to its notice that some private and corporate hospitals were reusing single-use devices after sterilising them, including items used in cardiology, nephrology, oncology, cardiothoracic and vascular surgery (CTVS), neurosurgery and other clinical services. The DGHS said that reuse could expose patients to cross-infection, device malfunction, reduced performance and other complications.

title: Chloë Grace Moretz bought LA home at 19 for $3.4m, sold it for $5.65m
content: Chloë Grace Moretz purchased a $3.4 million home in Studio City in 2016 and hosted numerous gatherings there. After seven years, she listed the property for almost $6 million and sold it for $5.65 million. The home features multiple entertainment spaces, a separate studio, and luxurious outdoor areas. Studio City remains a popular area for high-profile buyers, including Olivia Wilde, who sold her property in December 2025.

title: LA couple bought $925,000 farm, made barn a home, started cider business
content: David Bailey and Dana Tiel left their advertising careers to purchase a 16-acre farm in California. After spending $1 million, they converted a barn loft into their home. Their farm, Sierra Cider, includes a petting zoo, pumpkin patch and cider tastings. The couple faced challenges while balancing work and renovations during their transition. Despite initial doubts, the farm has become a popular destination for families and children.

title: After renaming Lake Ontario, Google CEO rejects US request to rename Atlantic Ocean
content: President Trump has recently proposed renaming the Atlantic Ocean, following prior discussions about the Atlantic Ocean. During a recent event, he mentioned contacting Google Maps regarding these renaming efforts. Google CEO Sundar Pichai reportedly declined his proposal on the grounds that oceans encompass multiple countries. This follows the US administration's earlier renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America for US users.

title: Florida couple missed 66 mortgage payments; man's bank lawsuit rejected
content: A Florida couple missed 66 monthly mortgage payments on their Naples property, triggering a foreclosure dispute that began in 2009. During the legal battle, Gregory Brian Myers agreed to deposit $5,000 monthly while appealing the foreclosure. He later sued U.S. Bank, alleging it had violated their agreement. On October 19, 2026, a federal appeals court upheld the dismissal of his lawsuit.

title: Two critical PHP flaws trigger global alert; millions of services face cyber risk
content: PHP advised users on Oct 23 to temporarily disable its session upload progress feature until the next regular bugfix release. The warning followed an earlier advisory on Oct 21 about a related vulnerability. The latest issue affects applications only when specific session settings are changed while running and the upload progress feature remains enabled. Users who have already disabled the feature do not need to take further action.

title: Cuba next? Trump hints at 'little stopover' after US warships return from Iran war
content: Trump and Rubio have both adopted a hard line towards Cuba's communist government. In May, the two renewed the possibility of US military intervention, with the threat gaining further significance after the Trump administration announced criminal charges against former Cuban leader Raúl Castro. Trump had floated a similar idea earlier this year but had not raised it publicly in recent months.

title: Tom Brady donates $170,000 speaking fee to charity
content: Tom Brady collected $170,000 for a speaking gig at Salem State University, generously donating the entire sum to charity. He allocated $50,000 to Best Buddies and distributed the remaining funds to various other organizations. With approximately 4,000 attendees present, ticket sales effectively covered his speaking fee. However, the event was notable for Brady facing questions about the NFL's Deflategate saga. The university reported a financial profit from hosting the event.

title: Andy Murray’s wife and four children: Inside his family life after retirement
content: Andy Murray has officially retired from professional tennis and, in doing so, has opened a new chapter in his life, and the former world No 1 will have more time to spend with his wife Kim Sears and their four children. From parenting and family routines to their shared business interests at Cromlix, the couple are handling life outside the demands of professional tennis while keeping family at the center.

title: ‘A racist terror attack’: Emmanuel Macron condemns deadly shooting near Paris
content: "These people were targeted because of their skin colour or perceived religion, and for no other reason," Macron said after meeting officials and residents in Trappes. "There is no place for this in France." Macron also said the suspect's statements indicated that the attack had been planned in advance. Police arrested the suspect less than 20 minutes after the shooting began.

title: Need to unite against divisive forces, tackle new challenges: PM Modi
content: Inaugurating the Chinmaya Amrit Mahotsav Global Sammelan, he said Swami Chinmayananda set his goals as per issues facing the country at the time and new challenges had emerged in the past few decades. “We must unite society against divisive forces. We must inspire citizens toward self-reliance, and we must connect every individual to vision of a developed India by 2047. For these objectives, we must become more proactive,” he said.

title: Ukrainian soldier cuts off his own foot to survive, rescued by drone after 8 months
content: Kostiantyn Vlasenko, 49, had been stranded in a boiler room with severe injuries after a Russian drone strike. With no way to escape and little hope of being rescued, he made a desperate decision to amputate his remaining foot to survive. On October 4, a large drone lifted him into the air using a harness and carried him 15km to safety.

title: Opposition's 'mock Parliament' to step up fight against SIR & CEC Gyanesh Kumar

The event will involve MPs and others, but is unlikely to be a large gathering, given that a massive show of strength to push for the CEC’s resignation is planned at Ramlila Maidan as a “Delhi chalo” rally.

title: Arms training case: US mercenary VanDyke, 6 Ukrainians to remain abroad till Feb 24

The seven accused had earlier sought six weeks to meet their families and were allowed to stay abroad till Oct 23. They were arrested on March 13 for allegedly training the insurgent-linked groups in Myanmar.

title: Northwest India turned drier, south wetter over 70 years, finds IMD study
content: In northwest India, the hot semi-arid zone grew from about a quarter of the region’s area in 1951-1980 to a third in 1991-2020, while the temperate zone shrank from about a quarter to less than a fifth, meaning that an area equal to roughly 7% of the region moved into the drier zone as temperatures rose and rainfall declined, said the study.

title: Brics parliamentary meet should end with joint statement: LS Speaker Om Birla
content: Talking to reporters Friday, Birla said the forum in India would work towards consensus-based dialogue on the role of Parliament in strengthening institutions, promotion of human-centred innovation in AI and digital technologies through Parliament, more representative system of global governance and role of Parliament in ensuring a sustainable and inclusive future for Brics countries.

title: New norms for cars from 2029: Rear-crash tests, data recorders
content: The ministry has set mandatory timelines for automakers to comply with other Automotive Industry Standards (AIS), covering occupant protection in offset frontal and lateral collisions, protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users, and fitment of immobilisers. The requirements will come into effect from April 2027 onwards. In a notification, the ministry also made AIS-192 mandatory for Event Data Recorders (EDRs) installed in cars from Oct 2029.

title: After Op Sindoor friction, Delhi & Baku reset ties with EAM Jaishankar's visit
content: Ties between the two countries had been held back by geopolitical reasons for a while, mainly Azerbaijan’s ties with Pakistan — as evident from its support for Islamabad after Op Sindoor last year — and India’s defence ties with Armenia. While Bayramov spoke about taking the relationship to a higher level, setting aside past differences, Jaishankar underlined the significance of trade and energy cooperation. Terrorism was also discussed.

title: Study traces how an El Niño changed the pollution map
content: Coming ahead of India’s peak pollution season, the paper, titled ‘Air quality in flux: The baffling ENSO transition in India’, published in Atmospheric Pollution Research journal Thursday, found that La Niña/El Niño conditions altered atmospheric circulation, PM2.5 transport pathways and weather conditions that determine whether pollution disperses or gets trapped.

title: 'It's a crime': UP CEO on alteration of 10,470 Pilbhit voters after SIR final roll
content: Uttar Pradesh's chief electoral officer revealed that two electoral officials and a computer operator have been implicated in voter record manipulation. A total of 10,470 voter records were altered without any supporting applications found in the offices. The manipulation was discovered after a voter noticed discrepancies in his registration details and reported them. Legal actions include criminal charges and potential disciplinary measures against the officials involved in the case.

title: GT player added to India squad as cover for injured Ishan Kishan for second T20I
content: Kushagra was part of the India A squad set to face New Zealand A in a three-match unofficial Test series beginning on Saturday in Lincoln. He will now join the senior team for the second T20I at Hagley Oval in Christchurch.

Congress has submitted a list of 175 to 200 constituencies where it believes it can perform well. SP leaders emphasize that seat allocation should be based on winnability rather than political bargaining.

Authorities are looking into the licensing and safety practices related to firecracker storage in the area.

This strategy includes imposing movement restrictions on Palestinians and conducting extensive weapon searches. With national elections looming on October 27, Netanyahu's government feels compelled to respond decisively amidst escalating violence and coalition partner pressures.
